t: 摩蒂默十字之战导致欧文·图多尔出事.

dz: "玫瑰之战":摩蒂默十字之战导致欧文·图多尔出事.
de: Wars of the Roses: The Battle of Mortimer's Cross results in the death of Owen Tudor.

t: 兰开斯特国王亨利六世被他的约克家族表弟废黜，后来成为国王爱德华四世。
te: Lancastrian King Henry VI is deposed by his House of York cousin, who then becomes King Edward IV.
dz: 英国玫瑰战争：兰开斯特国王亨利六世被他的约克家族表弟废黜，后来成为国王爱德华四世。
de: Wars of the Roses in England: Lancastrian King Henry VI is deposed by his House of York cousin, who then becomes King Edward IV.

de: Battle of Towton: Edward of York defeats Queen Margaret to become King Edward IV of England, bringing a temporary stop to the Wars of the Roses.

dz: 特雷比宗德帝国向苏丹迈赫梅德二世的部队投降. 这被一些历史学家视为拜占庭帝国的真正终结. 特雷比宗德皇帝大卫被放逐后被谋杀.
de: The Empire of Trebizond surrenders to the forces of Sultan Mehmed II. This is regarded by some historians as the real end of the Byzantine Empire. Emperor David of Trebizond is exiled and later murdered.
